label: Food
note: Guide mapping for /food/?q=<id>. Aliases are matched against plan text (lowercased, punctuation removed, whole words, optional plural).

avocado-toast.name: Avocado Toast with Tomato & Spinach
avocado-toast.summary: Whole grain toast topped with mashed avocado, greens and tomatoes — a filling breakfast with healthy fats and fibre.

photos.caption: Smashed avocado on toast with greens and tomatoes
photos.alt: Avocado Toast with Tomato & Spinach: smashed avocado on toast with greens and tomatoes

steps: Toast the bread until golden and firm enough to hold toppings.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Quickly wilt the spinach in a pan with a little olive oil.
Spread the avocado on the toast and top with spinach and sliced tomatoes.
Eat straight away, before the toast softens.
tips: Pair with a protein such as yogurt, an egg or a glass of milk to stay full longer.
Half an avocado is a typical portion; it is calorie-dense, so measure it if you track calories.
Mash avocado only when you are ready to eat; lemon juice slows browning.
aliases: avocado toast with tomato and spinach

chia-pudding.name: Chia Pudding
chia-pudding.summary: Chia seeds soaked in milk until they set into a creamy pudding, topped with fruit.

photos.caption: Chia seed pudding topped with fruit
photos.alt: Chia Pudding: chia seed pudding topped with fruit

steps: Stir 3 tbsp chia seeds into about 3/4 cup milk (almond, coconut or dairy).
Stir again after 5 minutes to break up clumps.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Top with fresh fruit such as berries or mango before serving.
tips: Make it the night before for a grab-and-go breakfast.
Chia seeds absorb a lot of water — drink a glass of water alongside.
Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; add fruit just before eating.
aliases: chia pudding with almond milk and fresh fruit
chia pudding with mango and coconut

chickpea-quinoa-salad.name: Chickpea and Quinoa Salad
chickpea-quinoa-salad.summary: Quinoa and chickpeas tossed with crunchy vegetables and a lemon or tahini dressing.

photos.caption: Chickpea salad with chopped vegetables
photos.alt: Chickpea and Quinoa Salad: chickpea salad with chopped vegetables

steps: Cook quinoa and let it cool.
Combine with chickpeas, diced cucumber, pepper, tomatoes and herbs.
Whisk lemon juice with tahini or olive oil, salt and pepper.
Toss everything together just before eating.
tips: Keeps well for packed lunches — store the dressing separately.
Add greens just before serving so they stay crisp.
aliases: chickpea salad with quinoa and mixed greens

cottage-cheese-toast.name: Cottage Cheese and Berry Toast
cottage-cheese-toast.summary: Toast topped with creamy cottage cheese and fresh berries — high in protein and quick to make.

photos.caption: Toasts topped with soft cheese and fresh berries
photos.alt: Cottage Cheese and Berry Toast: toasts topped with soft cheese and fresh berries

steps: Toast whole grain bread.
Spread a generous layer of cottage cheese.
Top with fresh berries.
Finish with a sprinkle of cinnamon or a few seeds if you like.
tips: Drain watery cottage cheese briefly so the toast stays crisp.
Eat soon after assembling.

cottage-cheese-pineapple.name: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple
cottage-cheese-pineapple.summary: Cottage cheese topped with sweet pineapple — a high-protein snack.

photos.caption: A bowl of cottage cheese
photos.alt: Cottage Cheese with Pineapple: a bowl of cottage cheese

steps: Spoon about 1/2 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with fresh or drained canned pineapple chunks.
Add a sprinkle of cinnamon or seeds if you like.
tips: Choose pineapple canned in juice rather than syrup.
A good evening snack — cottage cheese protein digests slowly.

falafel-bowl.name: Falafel Salad Bowl with Tahini
falafel-bowl.summary: Crisp falafel over salad, finished with a creamy tahini dressing.

photos.caption: Falafel served with salad
photos.alt: Falafel Salad Bowl with Tahini: falafel served with salad

steps: Bake or air-fry falafel until crisp (frying adds many calories).
Fill a bowl with greens, tomato, cucumber, pickled onion and a scoop of grains.
Thin tahini with lemon juice and water until pourable.
Top the bowl with falafel and drizzle with the dressing.
tips: Baked falafel has far less fat than deep-fried.
Add hummus for extra protein instead of more dressing.
aliases: falafel salad bowl with tahini dressing

fruit-nut-butter.name: Fruit with Nut Butter
fruit-nut-butter.summary: Fresh apple or banana with a spoon of peanut or almond butter — a balanced snack of fibre, fat and protein.

photos.caption: Apple slices served with a dip
photos.alt: Fruit with Nut Butter: apple slices served with a dip

steps: Wash the apple and slice it into wedges (or peel and slice the banana).
Measure 1–2 tbsp peanut or almond butter into a small bowl.
Dip the fruit as you eat.
tips: Measuring the nut butter keeps the snack within its planned calories.
Squeeze lemon over apple slices if packing them, to stop browning.
A good mid-afternoon or pre-workout snack.

greek-yogurt-parfait.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
greek-yogurt-parfait.summary: Layers of thick yogurt, fruit and crunchy toppings — a quick, protein-rich breakfast.

photos.caption: Yogurt parfaits with granola and blueberries
photos.alt: Greek Yogurt Parfait: yogurt parfaits with granola and blueberries

steps: Spoon a layer of Greek yogurt into a glass or bowl.
Add a layer of chopped fruit (berries or mango).
Sprinkle with granola or ground flaxseed.
Repeat the layers and finish with fruit on top.
tips: Add granola just before eating so it stays crunchy.
Choose plain yogurt and let the fruit provide sweetness.
Ground flaxseed is absorbed better than whole seeds.
aliases: greek yogurt parfait with granola and fresh fruit
greek yogurt parfait with mango and flaxseeds

grilled-eggplant-feta.name: Grilled Eggplant with Tomato and Feta
grilled-eggplant-feta.summary: Smoky grilled eggplant slices with tomato and crumbled feta — a light Mediterranean dinner.

photos.caption: Grilled peppers and eggplant with feta
photos.alt: Grilled Eggplant with Tomato and Feta: grilled peppers and eggplant with feta

steps: Slice eggplant into rounds, brush lightly with olive oil and season.
Grill or pan-roast for 3–4 minutes per side until soft and charred.
Toss chopped tomatoes with lemon juice, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Layer the eggplant with the tomato salad and crumble feta on top.
tips: Eggplant soaks up oil — brush it on rather than pouring.
Add chickpeas or serve with whole grain bread to make it more filling.
Tastes good warm or at room temperature.
aliases: grilled eggplant with tomato and feta salad

paneer-skewers.name: Grilled Paneer and Vegetable Skewers
paneer-skewers.summary: Spiced paneer cubes grilled on skewers with peppers and onions, served with brown rice.

photos.caption: Paneer tikka skewers with vegetables
photos.alt: Grilled Paneer and Vegetable Skewers: paneer tikka skewers with vegetables

steps: Mix yogurt with spices (chilli, cumin, garam masala), salt and lemon juice.
Coat paneer cubes, peppers and onion in the marinade for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill or bake at 220°C for 12–15 minutes, turning once.
Serve with brown rice and a squeeze of lemon.
tips: Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes so they don't burn.
Paneer is protein-rich but also high in fat — keep to the planned portion.
Add a cucumber salad or raita to balance the spices.
aliases: grilled vegetable and paneer skewers with brown rice

halloumi-salad.name: Grilled Vegetable and Halloumi Salad
halloumi-salad.summary: Seared halloumi on a salad of grilled vegetables and greens.

photos.caption: Halloumi salad with fresh greens
photos.alt: Grilled Vegetable and Halloumi Salad: halloumi salad with fresh greens

steps: Grill or roast vegetables such as zucchini, peppers and onion.
Slice halloumi and sear in a dry pan for 1–2 minutes per side until golden.
Arrange greens and grilled vegetables on a plate.
Top with the warm halloumi and dress with lemon and olive oil.
tips: Eat halloumi straight away — it turns rubbery as it cools.
Halloumi is salty, so go easy on added salt.

lentil-rice.name: Lentil and Vegetable Stir Fry with Brown Rice
lentil-rice.summary: Cooked lentils stir-fried with vegetables and spices, served with brown rice — a complete plant-protein meal.

facts.Good source of: Plant protein, fibre, iron, complex carbs

photos.caption: A plate of lentils cooked with rice
photos.alt: Lentil and Vegetable Stir Fry with Brown Rice: a plate of lentils cooked with rice

steps: Cook brown rice and lentils separately until tender (or use leftovers).
Sauté onion, garlic and cumin in a little oil.
Add diced vegetables and stir-fry for 4–5 minutes.
Fold in the lentils, season, and serve over the brown rice.
tips: Lentils plus rice provide all essential amino acids.
Top with yogurt (if not vegan) or a squeeze of lemon.
Keeps for 3 days in the fridge — a good lunchbox meal.
aliases: lentil and vegetable stir fry with brown rice

chickpea-wrap.name: Mediterranean Chickpea Wrap
chickpea-wrap.summary: A whole wheat wrap filled with mashed chickpeas or hummus and fresh vegetables.

photos.caption: Vegetable and hummus wrap
photos.alt: Mediterranean Chickpea Wrap: vegetable and hummus wrap

steps: Lightly mash chickpeas with lemon, garlic, herbs and a spoon of tahini (or use hummus).
Spread over a warmed whole wheat wrap.
Add cucumber, tomato, lettuce and red onion.
Roll tightly, folding in the sides, and cut in half.
tips: Wrap it in foil or paper to take with you.
Pack wet fillings separately if making ahead, so the wrap doesn't get soggy.

mushroom-pea-quinoa.name: Mushroom and Pea Stir Fry with Quinoa
mushroom-pea-quinoa.summary: Mushrooms and peas stir-fried with garlic and served over fluffy quinoa.

facts.Good source of: Plant protein, fibre, magnesium, B vitamins

photos.caption: Quinoa with mixed vegetables
photos.alt: Mushroom and Pea Stir Fry with Quinoa: quinoa with mixed vegetables

steps: Rinse quinoa, then simmer in twice its volume of water for 15 minutes; rest covered for 5.
Sauté sliced mushrooms in a little oil until browned.
Add peas, garlic and herbs and cook for 2–3 minutes.
Season and serve over the quinoa.
tips: Rinsing quinoa removes its natural bitter coating.
Quinoa is a complete protein — useful on meat-free days.
aliases: mushroom and pea stir fry with quinoa

oatmeal.name: Oatmeal with Fruit and Walnuts
oatmeal.summary: Warm oats cooked with milk or water and topped with fruit and walnuts — slow-release energy for the morning.

facts.Diet: Vegetarian · vegan with plant milk and no honey
facts.Commonly contains: Tree nuts (walnuts), gluten unless oats are certified gluten-free

photos.caption: Oatmeal topped with banana
photos.alt: Oatmeal with Fruit and Walnuts: oatmeal topped with banana

steps: Simmer 1/2 cup rolled oats with 1 cup milk or water for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Add sliced banana or diced apple and cinnamon in the last minute.
Spoon into a bowl and top with chopped walnuts.
Finish with a small drizzle of honey if you like.
tips: Eat it warm; add a splash of milk if it thickens while standing.
Prepare overnight oats instead if mornings are busy.
Keep honey to a teaspoon — the fruit already adds sweetness.
aliases: oatmeal with banana walnuts and honey
oatmeal with apple cinnamon and walnuts

orange-walnut-salad.name: Orange and Walnut Salad
orange-walnut-salad.summary: Fresh orange segments with greens and toasted walnuts — a bright, vitamin C-rich snack.

photos.caption: Orange salad with fresh greens
photos.alt: Orange and Walnut Salad: orange salad with fresh greens

steps: Peel the orange and slice it into rounds or segments.
Arrange over a handful of greens or rocket.
Top with a few toasted walnuts.
Drizzle with a little olive oil and a pinch of salt or black pepper.
tips: Toast walnuts briefly in a dry pan for extra flavour.
Eat soon after making so the greens stay crisp.

paneer-wrap.name: Paneer and Mixed Vegetable Wrap
paneer-wrap.summary: A whole wheat roti or wrap filled with spiced paneer and crunchy vegetables.

photos.caption: Homemade paneer roll
photos.alt: Paneer and Mixed Vegetable Wrap: homemade paneer roll

steps: Toss paneer strips with spices and sauté with sliced peppers and onion.
Warm a whole wheat roti or wrap.
Spread a little mint chutney or yogurt.
Add the paneer filling and fresh onions, roll up tightly and serve.
tips: Good for packed lunches — wrap in foil.
Add lettuce or cucumber for extra crunch and volume.

peanut-butter-toast.name: Peanut Butter Toast
peanut-butter-toast.summary: Multigrain toast spread with peanut butter and topped with banana or chia seeds — quick energy plus protein.

photos.caption: Toast with nut butter and banana slices
photos.alt: Peanut Butter Toast: toast with nut butter and banana slices

steps: Toast the multigrain bread.
Spread 1–2 tbsp peanut butter while the toast is warm.
Top with banana slices and/or a sprinkle of chia seeds.
Add a light drizzle of honey only if you want it sweeter.
tips: Measure the peanut butter — 1 tbsp is about 95 kcal.
Good 60–90 minutes before a morning workout.
Natural peanut butter (just peanuts and salt) has no added sugar.
aliases: multigrain toast with peanut butter and chia seeds

rajma.name: Rajma (Kidney Bean) Curry with Brown Rice
rajma.summary: Kidney beans slow-cooked in a spiced tomato-onion gravy and served with rice.

photos.caption: Rajma chawal — kidney bean curry with rice
photos.alt: Rajma (Kidney Bean) Curry with Brown Rice: rajma chawal — kidney bean curry with rice

steps: Soak dried kidney beans overnight, then boil or pressure-cook until completely soft (or use canned beans).
Sauté onion, ginger-garlic and spices, then add tomatoes and cook down.
Add the beans with some cooking liquid and simmer for 15–20 minutes.
Mash a few beans to thicken the gravy; serve with brown rice.
tips: Dried kidney beans must be boiled thoroughly — undercooked beans can cause stomach upset.
Beans plus rice make a complete protein.
Tastes even better the next day.
aliases: rajma kidney bean curry with brown rice

roasted-chickpeas.name: Roasted Chickpeas
roasted-chickpeas.summary: Crunchy oven-roasted chickpeas seasoned with spices.

photos.caption: Roasted chickpeas
photos.alt: Roasted Chickpeas: roasted chickpeas

steps: Rinse and thoroughly dry cooked or canned chickpeas.
Toss with 1 tsp oil and spices (paprika, cumin, salt).
Roast at 200°C for 25–35 minutes, shaking the tray halfway, until crunchy.
Cool completely before storing.
tips: Drying the chickpeas well makes them crunchier.
Store in an open jar or container — sealing them while warm makes them soft.
About 1/3 cup makes a satisfying portion.

smoothie-bowl.name: Smoothie Bowl
smoothie-bowl.summary: A thick blended fruit (and greens) base eaten with a spoon and topped with seeds, nuts or fruit.

photos.caption: Green smoothie bowl with muesli and chia seeds
photos.alt: Smoothie Bowl: green smoothie bowl with muesli and chia seeds

steps: Blend frozen banana or berries with a handful of spinach and a little yogurt or milk.
Use only enough liquid to blend — it should be thick enough to eat with a spoon.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with chia seeds, nuts, sliced fruit or a spoon of granola.
tips: Eat with a spoon and slowly — it is more filling than drinking a smoothie.
Frozen fruit gives a thick texture without ice.
Make and eat it fresh; it separates if left standing.
aliases: smoothie bowl with greek yogurt mixed berries and nuts
smoothie bowl with spinach banana and chia seeds

chana-palak.name: Spinach and Chickpea Curry
chana-palak.summary: Chickpeas simmered with spinach and spices — an iron-rich Indian classic.

photos.caption: Spinach and chickpea curry
photos.alt: Spinach and Chickpea Curry: spinach and chickpea curry

steps: Blanch spinach and blend to a purée (or chop finely).
Sauté onion, ginger-garlic, tomato and spices.
Add chickpeas and the spinach with a little water and simmer for 10 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and serve with brown rice.
tips: Lemon or tomato helps your body absorb the iron from spinach and chickpeas.
Avoid tea or coffee with this meal, as it reduces iron absorption.
aliases: spinach and chickpea curry with brown rice

spinach-mushroom-pasta.name: Spinach and Mushroom Whole Wheat Pasta
spinach-mushroom-pasta.summary: Whole wheat pasta tossed with sautéed mushrooms, garlic and spinach.

facts.Good source of: Fibre, B vitamins, iron, complex carbs
facts.Commonly contains: Gluten, dairy (if finished with cheese or cream)

photos.caption: Pasta with sautéed mushrooms and spinach
photos.alt: Spinach and Mushroom Whole Wheat Pasta: pasta with sautéed mushrooms and spinach

steps: Cook whole wheat pasta until just tender; save a cup of the cooking water.
Sauté sliced mushrooms and garlic in olive oil until golden.
Add spinach and stir until wilted.
Toss with the pasta, loosening with a little pasta water; season and serve.
tips: Keep the pasta portion as planned and pile on the vegetables.
A little grated parmesan adds flavour; heavy cream adds many calories.
aliases: spinach and mushroom whole wheat pasta

stuffed-bell-peppers.name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
stuffed-bell-peppers.summary: Bell peppers filled with brown rice or lentils and vegetables, then baked until tender.

photos.caption: Roasted red peppers stuffed with lentils
photos.alt: Stuffed Bell Peppers: roasted red peppers stuffed with lentils

steps: Halve the peppers and remove the seeds.
Mix cooked brown rice or lentils with sautéed onion, tomatoes, vegetables and spices.
Fill the peppers and place in a baking dish with a splash of water.
Cover and bake at 190°C for 30–35 minutes until the peppers are soft.
tips: One or two halves make a portion, depending on your plan.
Make a batch — they keep for 3 days in the fridge and reheat well.
aliases: stuffed bell peppers with brown rice and vegetables
stuffed bell peppers with lentils and vegetables

buddha-bowl.name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Buddha Bowl
buddha-bowl.summary: A colourful bowl of roasted sweet potato, black beans, grains and vegetables.

facts.Good source of: Fibre, plant protein, vitamin A, potassium

photos.caption: Buddha bowl with vegetables, grains and toppings
photos.alt: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Buddha Bowl: buddha bowl with vegetables, grains and toppings

steps: Roast cubed sweet potato with a little oil and spices at 200°C for 25 minutes.
Warm rinsed black beans with cumin.
Fill a bowl with a scoop of grains, greens and raw vegetables.
Add the sweet potato and beans, then a spoon of dressing or salsa.
tips: Prepare the components ahead and assemble bowls through the week.
Half an avocado or a few seeds add healthy fats.
aliases: sweet potato and black bean buddha bowl

tofu-skewers.name: Tofu and Vegetable Skewers with Brown Rice
tofu-skewers.summary: Marinated tofu and colourful vegetables grilled on skewers, served with brown rice.

photos.caption: Vegetable skewers being assembled
photos.alt: Tofu and Vegetable Skewers with Brown Rice: vegetable skewers being assembled

steps: Press and cube firm tofu, then marinate in soy sauce, garlic and a little oil for 20 minutes.
Thread tofu with cherry tomatoes, peppers, zucchini and onion.
Grill or bake at 220°C for 12–15 minutes, turning once.
Serve with brown rice.
tips: Soak wooden skewers so they don't burn.
Brush with leftover marinade halfway through cooking.
aliases: tofu and vegetable skewers with brown rice

tofu-stir-fry.name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir Fry
tofu-stir-fry.summary: Crisp tofu and vegetables stir-fried in a light soy-ginger sauce, served with rice or millet.

facts.Good source of: Plant protein, calcium (calcium-set tofu), fibre, vitamin C

photos.caption: Tofu stir-fry with vegetables
photos.alt: Tofu and Vegetable Stir Fry: tofu stir-fry with vegetables

steps: Press firm tofu for 10 minutes, then cube it.
Pan-fry the tofu in a little oil until golden; set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli and peppers over high heat for 3–4 minutes.
Return the tofu, add soy sauce, garlic and ginger, and toss.
Serve with cooked millet or rice.
tips: Pressing the tofu makes it crispier and absorbs more flavour.
Use tamari for a gluten-free version.
Cook vegetables quickly so they stay crunchy.
aliases: tofu stir fry with broccoli and bell peppers
vegetable and tofu stir fry with millet

trail-mix.name: Trail Mix (Nuts and Dried Fruit)
trail-mix.summary: A handful of mixed nuts, seeds and dried fruit — portable energy.

facts.Good source of: Healthy fats, protein, magnesium, vitamin E

photos.caption: Mixed nuts and dried fruit
photos.alt: Trail Mix (Nuts and Dried Fruit): mixed nuts and dried fruit

steps: Mix unsalted nuts (almonds, walnuts, cashews) with seeds and a few raisins or dried apricots.
Portion into small containers or bags of about 30 g each.
tips: It is calorie-dense — pre-portion rather than eating from the bag.
Choose unsalted nuts and dried fruit without added sugar.
aliases: trail mix with nuts and dried fruits

lentil-vegetable-soup.name: Vegetable and Lentil Soup
lentil-vegetable-soup.summary: A hearty soup of lentils and vegetables, served with whole grain bread.

photos.caption: A bowl of lentil and vegetable soup
photos.alt: Vegetable and Lentil Soup: a bowl of lentil and vegetable soup

steps: Sauté onion, carrot and celery in a little oil until soft.
Add rinsed lentils, chopped tomatoes, spices and stock or water.
Simmer for 25–30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Season, add a squeeze of lemon, and serve with whole grain bread.
tips: Soup is filling for relatively few calories — good for evening meals.
Freezes well in portions for up to 3 months.
Vitamin C from lemon or tomato helps absorb iron from lentils.
aliases: vegetable and lentil soup with whole grain bread
vegetable and lentil soup with whole wheat roll

paneer-curry.name: Vegetable and Paneer Curry
paneer-curry.summary: Paneer and mixed vegetables in a spiced tomato-onion gravy, served with brown rice or millet.

photos.caption: Kadai paneer with gravy
photos.alt: Vegetable and Paneer Curry: kadai paneer with gravy

steps: Sauté onion, ginger-garlic and spices until fragrant.
Add tomatoes and cook to a thick gravy.
Add mixed vegetables with a splash of water and simmer until tender.
Stir in paneer cubes and simmer for 3–4 minutes; serve with brown rice or millet.
tips: Add paneer at the end so it stays soft.
Use less oil and skip the cream to keep it lighter.
aliases: vegetable and paneer curry with brown rice
mixed vegetable and paneer curry with millet

vegetable-biryani.name: Vegetable Biryani with Raita
vegetable-biryani.summary: Fragrant spiced rice layered with vegetables, served with cool yogurt raita.

photos.caption: Vegetable biryani with pomegranate raita
photos.alt: Vegetable Biryani with Raita: vegetable biryani with pomegranate raita

steps: Par-cook basmati rice with whole spices (bay leaf, cardamom, cloves).
Cook mixed vegetables with onion, ginger-garlic and biryani masala.
Layer the rice over the vegetables, cover tightly and cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Mix yogurt with grated cucumber, cumin and salt for the raita; serve together.
tips: Fill half the plate with vegetables and raita, the rest with rice.
Raita cools the spice and adds protein.

tomato-basil-pasta.name: Vegetable Pasta with Tomato Basil Sauce
tomato-basil-pasta.summary: Pasta in a simple tomato and basil sauce with plenty of vegetables.

photos.caption: Pasta with fresh tomato and basil
photos.alt: Vegetable Pasta with Tomato Basil Sauce: pasta with fresh tomato and basil

steps: Cook pasta until just tender.
Sauté garlic in olive oil, add chopped tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add diced vegetables (zucchini, peppers, spinach) and cook until tender.
Toss with the pasta and fresh basil.
tips: Cooked tomatoes provide more absorbable lycopene than raw ones.
Keep pasta to the planned portion and add extra vegetables to fill the plate.
aliases: vegetable pasta with tomato basil sauce

veggie-sticks-hummus.name: Vegetable Sticks with Hummus
veggie-sticks-hummus.summary: Crunchy carrot and cucumber sticks with hummus for dipping.

photos.caption: Hummus with carrot
photos.alt: Vegetable Sticks with Hummus: hummus with carrot

steps: Peel the carrots and cut carrots and cucumber into sticks.
Spoon about 3–4 tbsp hummus into a small bowl.
Dip and enjoy.
tips: Keep cut vegetables in a container of water in the fridge to stay crisp.
Add pepper strips or cherry tomatoes for variety.
aliases: carrot and cucumber sticks with hummus

veggie-omelette.name: Veggie Omelette with Whole Wheat Toast
veggie-omelette.summary: Eggs cooked with mixed vegetables and served with toast — a protein-rich, balanced breakfast.

facts.Good source of: Protein, vitamins A and D, fibre

photos.caption: Vegetable omelette served with bread and chutney
photos.alt: Veggie Omelette with Whole Wheat Toast: vegetable omelette served with bread and chutney

steps: Whisk 2 eggs with salt and pepper.
Sauté chopped vegetables (tomato, pepper, spinach) in a little oil for 2–3 minutes.
Pour in the eggs and cook gently until the edges set, then fold.
Serve with a slice of whole wheat toast.
tips: Cook the eggs until fully set.
Fill with whichever vegetables are in season or need using up.
Best eaten hot; it does not reheat well.
aliases: veggie omelette with whole wheat toast

whole-wheat-pancakes.name: Whole Wheat Pancakes with Berry Compote
whole-wheat-pancakes.summary: Fluffy whole wheat pancakes served with a quick warm berry compote.

photos.caption: Pancakes topped with fresh berries
photos.alt: Whole Wheat Pancakes with Berry Compote: pancakes topped with fresh berries

steps: Whisk whole wheat flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt; mix in milk and egg until just combined.
Cook small ladles of batter on a lightly oiled pan until bubbles form, then flip.
For the compote, simmer berries with a splash of water for 5–8 minutes until saucy.
Serve the pancakes warm topped with the compote.
tips: Add Greek yogurt on the side for extra protein.
The compote replaces syrup — no extra sweetener needed.
Leftover pancakes freeze well; reheat in a toaster.
aliases: whole wheat pancakes with berry compote

yogurt-berries.name: Yogurt with Berries, Seeds and Nuts
yogurt-berries.summary: Plain yogurt topped with fresh berries and a sprinkle of seeds or nuts.

photos.caption: Yogurt cups with fresh berries
photos.alt: Yogurt with Berries, Seeds and Nuts: yogurt cups with fresh berries

steps: Spoon plain or Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with fresh or thawed frozen berries.
Sprinkle with a tablespoon of seeds (chia, flax, pumpkin) or chopped nuts.
tips: Plain yogurt avoids added sugar; the berries sweeten it.
Greek yogurt has roughly twice the protein of regular yogurt.
aliases: yogurt with mixed seeds and berries
greek yogurt with mixed berries and nuts

zucchini-noodles-pesto.name: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
zucchini-noodles-pesto.summary: Spiralised zucchini tossed with pesto and cherry tomatoes — a light, low-carb dinner.

facts.Commonly contains: Tree nuts (pine nuts), dairy (parmesan in pesto)

photos.caption: Spiralised zucchini noodles with pesto
photos.alt: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto: spiralised zucchini noodles with pesto
photos.credit: Tony Webster from Minneapolis, Minnesota, United States

steps: Spiralise the zucchini (or cut into thin ribbons with a peeler).
Sauté for 1–2 minutes only, so they stay firm.
Toss with pesto and halved cherry tomatoes off the heat.
Top with a little grated cheese or toasted seeds.
tips: Overcooked zucchini turns watery — keep it brief.
Add chickpeas or paneer if you need more protein.
Pesto is calorie-dense; 1–2 tbsp is enough.
aliases: zucchini noodles with pesto and cherry tomatoes
